rounds.text: Sampat Aluminium Ltd trades at an exceptionally low P/E ratio of 4.21x and a price-to-book ratio of 0.44x, offering a stark discount compared to sector benchmarks of 21.22x and 2.38x respectively [E1, E2, E6, E7]. The business has demonstrated phenomenal long-term compounding, achieving a 95% compounded profit growth rate over five years and a 20% compounded sales growth rate over the same period, paired with an elite historical return on equity track record featuring a 5-year median ROE of 31% [E14, E17, E21, E44]. Furthermore, intrinsic value models highlight a dramatic mispricing, with a discounted cash flow valuation pointing to a margin of safety of 89.8% while the reverse DCF implies that the market is excessively penalizing the stock by pricing in -15.1% earnings growth [E38, E39]. Fundamental operational strength is visible in the recent expansion of operating margins to 5% from 1% three years prior, alongside deliberate deleveraging that reduced borrowings to Rs 20 Cr from Rs 24 Cr [E24, E31]. Conceded: the company reported negative operating and free cash flows in March 2026 alongside a 14% contraction in trailing twelve-month profit growth [E19, E28, E29].
